description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.040 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Dealer gamma exposure (GEX) analysis for any US stock or ETF — returns aggregate GEX, gamma flip level, key pinning strikes, and vol regime signal (positive GEX = pinning, negative = acceleration). Free CBOE delayed data, no API key. Standard SpotGamma-style calculation: calls subtract gamma, puts add gamma. Use with options-snapshot for full options context.

days_out.description: Include only options expiring within this many calendar days. Default: 45 (captures standard monthly + weekly expiries).

ticker.description: US equity or ETF ticker (e.g. SPY, QQQ, AAPL, NVDA). Case-insensitive.

top_n.description: Number of top positive and negative GEX strikes to return. Default: 10.

name: market-gex

gamma_flip.description: Strike where net GEX crosses zero (gamma flip level). Null if no crossing found.

key_strikes.description: Top strikes by absolute GEX (both positive and negative), sorted by abs GEX descending.

negative_gex_wall.description: Lowest aggregate negative-GEX strike — acts as downside acceleration level.

options_count.description: Number of options included in the analysis.

positive_gex_wall.description: Highest aggregate positive-GEX strike — acts as upside resistance/pin.

total_gex.description: Aggregate dealer gamma exposure in USD. Positive = net long gamma; negative = net short gamma.
